body:
Thanks everyone for attending! Here are the notes from this meeting (the next one is at https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8341):

### Agenda

1. Review past action items
    1. Emilio will make sure the Gecko patch for [focus delegate code seems wrongly only looking at children](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8157) includes enough test coverage.
        1. Emilio will ping the patch author or take over and send the patch to Olli.
    1. Anne to check with WebKit canvas people, post an update on [Rendering of "bitmaprenderer"-backed canvas](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7833), ideally including a concrete proposal for a spec change everyone can converge on.
        1. No progress.
    1. Domenic to do spec work for [Define timing of focus fixup rule precisely when triggered by style changes](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8225), Emilio to update tests.
        1. The tests are ready to land, Domenic needs to do the spec work.
        1. Tests at [https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D156219](https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D156219).
1. Carryovers from last time
    1. [Domenic] [Define link processing for prefetch](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/8111)
        1. Made progress at TPAC, will continue discussing in the issue.
1. New topics
    1. [Domenic] [Is a general Script: header a good idea?](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8321)
        1. The consensus was to use separate headers.
    1. [Emilio] [Intersection observer and mark paint timing steps should run after (or during) "update the rendering", not before](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8277)
        1. Emilio will send a PR to make it so, including upstreaming ResizeObserver.
    1. [Olli] [Event bubbling on disabled form elements](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/5886)
        1. Joey will land a change to change Chromium's behavior.
    1. [Domenic] [Iframes should inherit the base URL of the parent document in some cases](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/421)
        1. Emilio notes that Gecko does srcdoc dynamically, but thinks changing this should be fine.
        1. Domenic will continue work on this.
    1. [Emilio] Let's talk about [HTMLOptionsCollection length setter should specify what happens when you go over the option limit](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8337)!
        1. Emilio will add a spec change for this, consensus was to align on WebKit's behavior (clamp the value and warn in the console).

### Action Items

1. @emilio will ping the patch author for [focus delegate code seems wrongly only looking at children](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8157) or take over and send the patch to @smaug----.
1. @domenic needs to do the spec work for [Define timing of focus fixup rule precisely when triggered by style changes](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8225).
1. @emilio will send a PR to make [Intersection observer and mark paint timing steps run after (or during) "update the rendering", not before](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8277), including upstreaming ResizeObserver.
1. @josepharhar will land a change to change Chromium's behavior around [Event bubbling on disabled form elements](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/5886).
1. @emilio will add a spec change for [HTMLOptionsCollection length setter should specify what happens when you go over the option limit](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8337).
